independent_actual_source_checks.matching_targets_sql: SELECT sp.node_id,sp.id,sp.specRelease,s.node_id,s.sectionNumber,s.sectionTitle FROM Spec sp LEFT JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC e ON e.dst_id=sp.node_id LEFT JOIN Section s ON s.node_id=e.src_id AND s.sectionNumber='5.1.3.2' WHERE sp.specNumber='38.214' AND (s.node_id IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC z WHERE z.dst_id=sp.node_id)) ORDER BY sp.node_id,s.node_id
